text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle opening the full reward proposition
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the ayah as a confirmed reward proposition. Before the class is named, assertion-force is already in place, so the promise is not a loose continuation after warning but a settled counter-claim. The particle governs the relative subject and the later reward clause together, making the whole positive outcome stand against the prior denial scene.

topics.headline: assertion scopes the reward claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is framed from the first word as a settled assertion, not as narrative drift.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the whole ayah as an inna-clause whose subject and reward predicate fall under the opening particle.

topics.headline: warning turns into confirmed recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse pivot from denial and warning into emphatic counter-affirmation.
topics.reason: The boundary rows cohere with the emphatic particle and no local evidence blocks the contrastive assertion force.

words.gloss_range: definite relative class-marker whose identity is supplied by the following faith-and-action clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the rewarded people into a defined class. The following verbs fill in that class, so belief and sound action belong to one antecedent rather than to separate groups. Because the relative clause comes before the reward statement, recompense is structurally downstream from the profile that qualifies its recipients. At the boundary from 41:7, this new class-marker replaces a denial-class with a believer-class defined by its ṣila.

topics.headline: relative pronoun forms a bounded class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines a class by its following clause rather than naming a tribe, label, or inherited status.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the governed subject phrase of the inna-clause, and its semantic work is grammatical classification.

topics.headline: one antecedent holds faith and action together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group is qualified by both verbs before any reward is disclosed.
topics.reason: Local coordination keeps the two verbal predicates under the same relative head.

topics.headline: denial-class replaced by believer-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene shift from a prior denial-class into a newly defined recipient-class.
topics.reason: The boundary claim is compatible with the relative class-marker and adds a discourse payoff.

words.gloss_range: Form IV established faithful trust without an overt object; broader safety/security branches are narrowed here by the faith-work frame
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-m-n covers safety, trust, reliability, and belief; the local Form IV perfect plural selects entered faithful trust as a class-defining act
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) begins the class definition with established faithful trust. Its Form IV perfect plural makes trust an entered relation and a completed identity-marker, while the missing overt object lets the discourse frame supply the trusted horizon instead of narrowing it to one named complement. The broader security field remains useful, but local grammar selects faithful trust that must move next into action and reward; same-surah returns at 41:44 and formula parallels at 84:25, 95:6, and 103:3 reinforce that this first verb is part of a faith-work-recompense profile.

topics.headline: objectless perfect plural marks class faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as an established class condition whose object is supplied by the discourse frame rather than named inside the verb phrase.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV perfect plural and the attachment evidence records no explicit object.

topics.headline: security field narrowed to faithful trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief carries trust and reliability pressure, while local form and context keep mere safety-state readings out of the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root field supports safety and trust associations, but the local Form IV faith-work frame selects entered faithful trust.

topics.headline: faith starts the work-reward sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that faith is the first node in a sequence that moves into action and then assigned recompense.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and local coordination rows align: this verb precedes the coordinated work verb inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: faith answers denial and recurs in reception scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local faith term answers boundary denial and participates in wider formula settings such as 41:44, 84:25, and 95:6.
topics.reason: The supplied references are concrete parallels or same-surah returns, and they do not override the local parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining faith and action inside one relative profile without itself forcing chronology
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the two verbs inside one relative profile. It keeps faith and action distinct enough to be heard as two predicates, but joined enough that reward does not attach to either one in isolation. The light prefixed particle also makes the second verb enter visibly and audibly as a coordinated member, without making the particle alone bear a strict chronology.

topics.headline: faith and action joined, not collapsed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief and action are co-defining criteria rather than rival or severable reward routes.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the work verb as coordinated with the faith verb by this particle.

topics.headline: union without forced chronology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the joining force and prefixed sound-link while not overreading wa as a strict temporal sequence by itself.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the verbs, but ordinary wa coordination does not itself force chronology.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural direct doing with an explicit sound-deeds object; broader operating or employing branches are not selected
words.root_gloss_range: ʿ-m-l covers doing, working, operating, and producing; the local Form I verb with an explicit object selects enacted moral work
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) carries the class definition from trust into performed action. The same plural subject remains in view, and unlike the preceding objectless faith verb, this verb reaches an explicit object, so the action is concrete and bounded by soundness. The ʿ-m-l work-field supports enacted production, but the local Form I frame keeps the sense at direct doing, not causative employing; its formula links with 103:3 and its local answer in the reward noun make work part of a moral economy rather than a detachable merit. Against the defiant work-language of 41:5 and the positive action profile at 41:33, this verb selects the rewarded pole of the surah's work vocabulary.

topics.headline: same class performs object-directed work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same believers perform deeds that are grammatically concrete through an explicit object.
topics.reason: The work verb is coordinated with the faith verb and takes the following sound-deeds noun as explicit object.

topics.headline: work-field selected as direct doing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices action as operative output while local Form I prevents shifting the sense toward causing, employing, or merely making something function.
topics.reason: The broad work field is real, but the local Form I perfect with an object selects direct enacted work.

topics.headline: work prepares the recompense vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is not erased after faith; it prepares the later reward term as fitting return.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows and local sequence join work with sound deeds and recompense.

topics.headline: sound work contrasts refused action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between defiant or refused action and the performed sound acts that define the rewarded class.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah and boundary references give contrast without changing the local verb sense.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active-participle substantive naming recognized sound or repairing deeds as the object of action
words.root_gloss_range: ṣ-l-ḥ covers soundness, rightness, repair, and fitness; the local plural substantive selects deeds characterized by durable soundness
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) completes the action phrase by naming the object that work reaches. Its definite plural active-participle shape treats the deeds as a recognized class marked by durable soundness, not as vague good intention. The ṣ-l-ḥ repair and fitness field survives as positive pressure: these are deeds characterized by sound-making quality, and their position closes the relative qualification immediately before the reward appears. Formula echoes such as 18:107 keep that sound-action profile attached to recompense, while the boundary from 41:7 makes soundness answer refused purification with performed repair. The assimilated emphatic ṣ onset gives the soundness term a heavier audible opening.

topics.headline: sound deeds are the worked object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action takes a defined object: the class is qualified by performed sound deeds.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this plural participial noun the explicit object of the work verb.

topics.headline: repair field names durable deed-quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are marked by soundness and repair, while local grammar keeps the referent as deeds rather than abstract repair in general.
topics.reason: The root field supports soundness and repair, but the feminine plural substantive object selects deeds characterized by that quality.

topics.headline: last qualification before reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the relative clause closes on deed-quality before the reward clause opens.
topics.reason: Local clause order makes this object the final qualifier before recipient-fronting and reward.

topics.headline: soundness answers failure and joins reward formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a wider faith-work-soundness pattern, including 18:107, while the local payoff remains the completed object of work.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels and boundary rows are concrete and compatible with the local object role.

topics.headline: assimilated onset intensifies the term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the intensified onset as a small acoustic emphasis on the soundness term.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds a distinct sound-level payoff tied to this surface form.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām of allocation, benefit, and belonging, fronted with the pronoun before the reward noun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the fronted recipient phrase before the reward noun is heard. By governing the pronoun, it assigns the coming recompense to the already defined class and lets entitlement precede any measure of the reward. Its lām range includes benefit, possession, and allocation; locally those pressures converge as reward-for-them rather than a loose possessive afterthought.

topics.headline: fronted lām phrase assigns reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recipient assignment arrives before the reward noun itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun as governed by lām in a fronted predicate phrase.

topics.headline: benefit and allocation converge locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices more than bare possession: the lām marks benefit and allocation restricted to the qualified class.
topics.reason: The semantic range is broader than one English preposition, but local syntax selects allocated benefit in the reward frame.

topics.headline: attached lām delays reward measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the small prefixed particle as the start of a fronted phrase that delays the reward noun.
topics.reason: The bundle splits the lām from the pronoun, but local syntax keeps them together as the fronted predicate phrase.

words.gloss_range: bound third masculine plural pronoun resuming the full relative class as the reward recipient
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) resumes the full relative class inside the fronted reward frame. The pronoun is bound rather than an independent new topic, so the recipients are exactly the ones just defined by faith and sound action. It compresses that whole qualification into one beneficiary slot before the reward appears. After 41:7 used the same pronoun shape for the opposed class, this pronoun reassigns the slot to the believers; its nasal sound also anticipates the final closure word, tying who receives the reward to what cannot happen to it.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the defined class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward recipient is the same fully qualified class, not a new group.
topics.reason: The pronoun agrees with and refers back to the relative class under the lām phrase.

topics.headline: qualification compressed into recipient slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith and action compressed into a single beneficiary pronoun before reward is named.
topics.reason: The bound pronoun sits inside the preposed phrase and carries the completed relative class into the predicate.

topics.headline: fronting restricts reward assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fronted phrase restricts the reward to the class already defined.
topics.reason: The fronted lām-pronoun construction supports recipient focus and restriction.

topics.headline: pronoun sound and class reassignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun as both a reassigned class marker after denial and an audible bridge toward the final nasal close.
topics.reason: The boundary and sound rows add distinct local payoffs without changing the pronoun reference.

words.gloss_range: indefinite recompense or wage-like return, delayed after the recipient phrase and then protected by the following qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-j-r covers recompense, wage, hire, and reward; the local noun selects fitting return for the faith-work profile without reducing it to a commercial payment
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرٌ}} ({{tr:ajrun}}) finally names the recompense after the recipients have been foregrounded. Its indefinite singular form leaves the measure open, while its nominative role completes the fronted nominal predicate and receives the following protective qualifier. The ʾ-j-r wage-reward field makes the outcome a fitting return for the faith-work profile without shrinking it into a commercial transaction. Formula echoes at 68:3, 84:25, and 95:6 show that this unmeasured reward belongs to a repeated durable-recompense closure. Its tanwīn begins the compact closing cadence that binds reward, exclusion, and denied interruption into one unit.

topics.headline: unmeasured reward after recipient-fronting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward disclosed only after recipient entitlement is foregrounded, and its amount remains unmeasured.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite delayed nominative in the fronted predicate construction.

topics.headline: reward awaits protective qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward beat is incomplete until the following qualifier defines its immunity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following negating phrase a modifier of the reward noun.

topics.headline: wage field selected as fitting return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recompense as a fitting return for action, while local theology and grammar prevent reducing it to a merely commercial wage.
topics.reason: The root family supports wage and recompense senses; the local faith-work frame selects reward as due return without transaction literalism.

topics.headline: formula extends durable reward to the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase joins repeated reward closures at 68:3, 84:25, and 95:6, here applied to the plural faith-action class.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels are concrete and match the local reward formula.

topics.headline: action answered by recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that performed work is answered by recompense rather than disappearing once the qualification ends.
topics.reason: Local sequence and co-occurrence rows link work, soundness, and reward.

topics.headline: closing cadence binds reward and immunity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward noun as part of a compact closing cadence that binds assignment, reward, and non-expiry.
topics.reason: The sound row and convergence row add a surface-level payoff consistent with the phrase structure.

words.gloss_range: construct noun of otherness functioning as a negating modifier: the reward is outside the mamnūn category, not merely momentarily uncut
words.root_gloss_range: gh-y-r covers otherness, difference, alteration, and change; the local construct selects categorical exclusion from the following vulnerable state
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرُ}} ({{tr:ghayru}}) begins the final exclusion hinge. As a construct noun modifying the reward and governing the last word, it turns negation into classification: the reward belongs outside the vulnerable state being named. The gh-y-r field of otherness and alteration is locally selected as categorical other-than, not list-exception or a finite changing event. Echoes with 13:11 and 41:15 sharpen the contrast: here otherness protects reward from alteration into severance.

topics.headline: construct modifier packs negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices negation compressed into a construct modifier rather than expanded into a separate clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as a modifier of reward and construct head governing the final participle.

topics.headline: otherness classifies the reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is classified outside the mamnūn category, while exception-listing and finite change readings are not selected.
topics.reason: The broader otherness range is real, but the local construct with the passive participle selects categorical exclusion.

topics.headline: alteration field becomes immunity from change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices alteration pressure reversed into protection: the reward does not enter an altered, diminished class, with 13:11 as contrast.
topics.reason: The root can mark changed states elsewhere, but local syntax uses otherness to exclude the reward from harmful alteration.

topics.headline: final phrase begins with exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the last movement of the ayah beginning by naming the class the reward cannot enter.
topics.reason: The word starts the final modifier phrase and participates in the repeated reward formula at 68:3, 84:25, and 95:6.

topics.headline: contrast and sound move into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah contrast at 41:15 and the audible movement from rough exclusion into the final nasal close.
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah and sound rows add local payoff without changing the construct role.

topics.headline: ghayru binds reward and final state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reward, exclusion, and the denied condition bound into one phrase whose decisive attribute arrives at the end.
topics.reason: The word links the reward noun to the final complement and delays the decisive attribute.

words.gloss_range: passive participle naming the denied state of being cut off, diminished, or made a reproachful favor
words.root_gloss_range: m-n-n covers cutting/diminishing and favor that can burden with obligation; the local passive participle under ghayru denies both loss of duration and loss of dignity
words.prose: {{ar:مَمْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:mamnūnin}}) supplies the final condition from which the reward is excluded. Its passive participle form makes vulnerability visible without naming a cutter, diminisher, or reproacher; the preceding negating construct then denies exposure to that whole class. The m-n-n field lets the ending deny both interruption and humiliating favor, so the promise protects duration and dignity together. As the last word, it seals the repeated reward formula found at 84:25 and 95:6, while its nasal close lets the ayah sound closed even as the meaning denies termination. The m/n thread also reaches back to the recipient pronoun, binding the assigned recipients to the non-expiring quality of what they receive.

topics.headline: passive participle names denied vulnerability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward as something that could have been acted upon, then hears that vulnerability denied.
topics.reason: The word is a passive participle governed by the preceding construct and functioning as the excluded state.

topics.headline: final word completes the construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word is not an independent adjective but the complement that completes what kind of reward is promised.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as genitive complement of the construct head.

topics.headline: cut-off and reproach denied together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is protected both from termination and from being turned into humiliating obligation.
topics.reason: The root field supports both cutting/diminution and reproachful favor, while local negation denies the whole state rather than activating a giver scene.

topics.headline: last term seals repeated formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word as the closure term in a durable-reward formula repeated at 84:25 and 95:6.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels repeat the formula in judgment contexts and fit the local reward clause.

topics.headline: warning resolves into protected reward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah landing not on reward amount but on the denied condition of expiry or reproach.
topics.reason: The final position and rare formulaic form carry the boundary shift into protected reward closure.

topics.headline: sound closes while meaning denies closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the nasal acoustic closure working against the semantic denial of reward-termination.
topics.reason: The sound rows give a distinct surface-level payoff tied to the final word.

topics.headline: nasal texture binds recipient and ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ending compressing formula, root senses, and sound texture into one closure term.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence, echo, wordplay, and sound rows converge on the same final-word payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ءامنوا وعملوا الصالحات ... أجر غير ممنون.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust becomes intentional action that opposes corruption; the resulting return is placed outside cutting or depletion. The verse thus links an inwardly secured stance, outward repair, and a continuously available yield.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust supply the inwardly stabilized starting condition.
Heart-settling assent makes belief an operative commitment rather than a bare label.
Intentional action converts the settled commitment into purposive conduct.
Soundness against corruption gives the conduct its reparative direction.
Return for work supplies the consequence produced for the agents.
Exclusion and negation place the return outside the following limitation.
Cutting and diminution name the failure mode explicitly excluded from the return.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive an everlasting reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust issues in deliberate repair, and that repair yields a return kept outside every process of severance or depletion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of الصالحات and أجر, with غير ممنون qualifying the latter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repair branch of صالح and the fracture-setting branch of أجر form a material mechanism: reparative acts are answered by a mending that remains available even where damage has healed imperfectly. Non-cutting keeps that restorative response from expiring.

activation_trace.role: Opposition to corruption supplies the initiating work of restoration.
Setting a broken member, even with residual crookedness, recasts the return as compensatory mending.
The excluded cut makes the mending durable rather than a one-time settlement.

changed_reading.before: The reward is payment appended to good conduct.
changed_reading.after: The reward can also be heard as an enduring setting-right that answers acts of setting-right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negative construction غير ممنون attached directly to أجر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation can exclude not only interruption but the social burden of a benefactor repeatedly invoking the favor. The return is therefore possessed without humiliation, leverage, or a rehearsed debt of gratitude.

activation_trace.role: A return due for action supplies the benefit granted to the recipients.
Categorical exclusion removes the following mode from the benefit.
Burdening a recipient by recounting a favor supplies the social debt that is excluded.

changed_reading.after: The reward is also never weaponized against its recipients as a favor they must keep repaying socially.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence distinguishes mere activity from صالح action. Work performed from behind a barrier is answered by straight orientation, giving, and growth; in 41:8, صالحات therefore become directed acts that reopen blocked relation and circulation.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action is the focus anchor whose quality the nearby contrast revises.
Removal of social estrangement makes صالحات capable of naming restored relation.
Prevention of access supplies the blocked relational condition from which rival work proceeds.
Intentional work on both sides shows that activity alone does not distinguish صالح work.
Straightness and rectitude supply the direction that turns activity into aligned action.
Giving supplies the outward transfer whose refusal marks the negative case.
Growth and increase make giving a circulation that produces life beyond the giver.

summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing repeatedly converted a reward noun into mechanisms: maintained provision, embodied consequence, protective relation, social repair, regeneration, safe arrival, and benefit returning to the acting self. The repeated focus roots at 41:33, 41:40, and 41:46 made those changes especially traceable.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reward as an unsevered extension of action.** **ع م ل B001** supplies intentional doing, **ص ل ح B001** sound rectitude, and **م ن ن B001** cutting off or diminishing an extension. The negation attaches the non-cutting image to recompense. I infer continuity between sound action and its outcome. The reward reads not only as abundant but as a relation that is never severed.
2. **Reward without humiliating leverage.** **م ن ن B003** supplies a weighty favor and the reminder of it. Negation permits a second accepted branch: the reward is not turned into a debt by reproach. I infer that divine giving does not subordinate the recipient through repeated reminders. This social reading coexists with temporal unendingness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:31–32 gives the unsevered relation a social form: continuing guardianship and guest-provision. 41:46 later clarifies that action returns to the acting self, strengthening continuity without making reward a coercive favor.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Restorative work enters an uncut return.** Lexically, `ع م ل B001` is intentional doing, `ص ل ح B001` soundness or setting right against corruption, `ء ج ر B001` recompense for work, and `م ن ن B001` an extension being cut off or diminished, explicitly including undiminished reward. Structurally, the work/recompense pairing answers the withheld giving of 41:7, while 41:10 depicts provision measured into the created order. I assign sound works the role of repairing the field in which one acts and reward the role of a return whose continuity is not severed. The inferred arrow is that restorative action participates in a sustaining economy rather than a one-time payment. “Uncut” therefore becomes a structural reversal of withheld circulation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:10’s apportioned sustenance sharpened “uncut reward” into a contrast between measured provision and severed continuity. 41:13’s warning also showed that enduring return and exemplary consequence are parallel outputs of action.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durum olarak kurar; ayrıca bu duruma gelmeyi, bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi ve belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranmayı da kapsar. Geçici çerçeve bu durum, süreç ve ettirgen işlem ayrımlarını doğru biçimde bir arada tutmaktadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kişiler, işler ve şeylerdeki iyi durum ile bu durumu sağlama bu dala girer; kişiler arası uzlaşma, uygunluk ve özel adlar ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimlerdeki iyi ve düzgün olma çekirdeğini, düzeltme türevlerini ve yalnızca belirli yapıda görülen iyi davranma kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durumdur. Bu eksen kişinin ve işin iyi olmasını, bir şeyi düzeltmeyi, yarar sağlayan şeyi, iyi duruma getirmeyi istemeyi ve özel bir yapıda hayvana iyi davranmayı kapsar; insanın iyi yaratılması, bozukluğunun giderilmesi veya iyi sayılması da düzeltmenin farklı gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. Geçici çerçeve uygunluk ilişkisini doğru saptamış ve ahlaki iyilik ya da bozukluğu düzeltme anlamlarını bu dala katmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca verilen kişi yönelimli yapıda bir şeyin o kişiye uymasıdır; yalın bir iyi olma veya genel düzeltme anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun olduğunu bildiren kalıba bağlıdır; bu kullanım yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yapıda, bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun düşmesi, ona uyması ve onun alanından sayılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey ile yöneldiği kişi arasında uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi bulunur.
Uygun görülen şey, kişinin alanına veya türüne ait sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı ifade, belirli bir şeyin muhataba uygun olduğunu onun alanından veya türünden sayılma açıklamasıyla verir; anlam bütünüyle bu kişi yönelimli yapıya bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uyduğunu bildiren kaynak yapısının kişi yönelimli uygunluk ilişkisini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Şey ile kişi arasındaki uygunluk ilişkisini ve yapının kişi yönelimli sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne, seçenek veya işin muhatabın alanına, durumuna ya da niteliğine uygun olduğu söylenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun düşmesini doğal bir cümle içinde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bu sana uygundur; bu sana uyar

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kökten türeyen birden fazla biçimin kişilere ad olarak verildiğini ve bunlardan birinin bir peygamberin adı olduğunu açıkça bildirir. Geçici çerçeve ad kullanımını sıradan bir kişilik niteliğinden ayırdığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca kök türevlerinin kişi adı olarak kullanılmasını kapsar; aynı biçimlerin iyi ve düzgün kimseyi nitelemesi ayrı anlamdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yapılan işten doğan yararlı karşılığı ana anlam olarak verir ve bunun dünyalık ödeme, manevi ödül, kiralama bedeli, evlilikte kadına verilen bedel ve ücret karşılığı çalıştırma gibi gerçekleşmelerini açıkça kapsar. Hazırlık çerçevesi bu katmanları aynı yararlı karşılık çekirdeğine bağlı tuttuğu için branch kimliği kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca yararlı bir dönüşü kapsar; zararlı karşılık ve ceza bu branchin sınırları dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak yararlı karşılık çekirdeğini verir; kiralama, işçi tutma, evlilik bedeli ve çocuk ölümüyle ilgili kullanımları yalnızca kendi biçim veya kuruluşlarına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yapılması veya bir anlaşmanın kurulması nedeniyle kişiye dönen yararlı karşılıktır; bu karşılık dünyalık bir ödeme ya da manevi ve öte dünyaya ilişkin bir ödül olabilir. Kiralama bedeli, ücretle çalıştırma ve evlilikte kadına verilen bedel bu çekirdeğin belirli ilişkilere bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Yapılan bir iş nedeniyle işi yapan kişiye yarar olarak dönen karşılıktır.
Karşılık, dünyalık bir ödeme, kiralama bedeli veya hizmet sözleşmesinde verilen bedel olabilir.
Karşılık, iyi bir iş için bu dünyada veya öte dünyada beklenen manevi ödül olabilir.
Evlilik ilişkisinde kadına verilmesi gereken bedel de yararlı karşılık olarak adlandırılır.
Bir kişiyi bedel karşılığında çalıştırmak üzere tutma ve o kişiyi çalışan kılma ilişkisini de kapsar.
Ölen çocukların, anne veya baba için öte dünyaya ilişkin bir ödüle dönüşmesi özel bir kuruluşta anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tablosunda ana unsur, iş veya anlaşma sonucunda kişiye yarar sağlayan bir karşılığın dönmesidir. Bu karşılık ödül, çalışma ya da kiralama bedeli ve evlilikte kadına verilen bedel biçiminde gerçekleşebilir; ayrıca birini bedel karşılığı çalışan olarak tutma ilişkisine ve ölen çocukların manevi ödül sayıldığı özel kuruluşa uzanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kırık kemiğin birleştirilmesini genel çekirdek olarak verirken diğer aktarımlar eğri, çıkıntılı veya düzgün olmayan biçimde kaynamayı özellikle belirtir. Uyak harflerinin farklılığı da bağımsız bir çekirdek değil, düzensiz birleşmeye dayandırılan teknik bir uzantıdır. Bu nedenle hazırlık çerçevesi kullanılabilir, fakat bütün örnekleri yalnızca eğri kaynamaya indirgememek gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel kırık onarımı çekirdektir; eğri kaynama güçlü bir uzmanlaşma, uyak uyuşmazlığı ise buna bağlı teknik uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kırığın birleştirilmesi çekirdeğini korur; eğri kaynama belirli biçim ve kuruluşlarda öne çıkar, uyak anlamıysa yalnızca şiir tekniğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Kırılmış kemik ya da elin birleştirilip kaynamasıdır; birçok kullanımda eğri, çıkıntılı veya düzgün olmayan bir biçimde iyileşme özellikle belirtilir. Şiirde karşılık gelen uyak harflerinin farklı olması, bu düzensiz birleşmeye benzetilen teknik bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: Kırılmış kemiği veya eli birleştirme ve yeniden kaynatma sürecini anlatır.
Birleşen kemiğin eğri, çıkıntılı ya da düzgün olmayan biçimde kaynaması birçok kullanımın belirleyici koşuludur.
Şiirde karşılık gelen uyakların farklı harflerle bitmesi, düzensiz kaynamaya benzetilen teknik bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kırık kemiğin veya elin birleştirilmesini ortak zemin olarak sunar; bazı aktarımlar sonucu özellikle eğri, çıkıntılı ya da düzgün olmayan kaynama olarak sınırlar. Uyaklarda denk konumlardaki harflerin farklı olması da bu fiziksel düzensizlikten türetilmiş teknik bir kullanım olarak açıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi referenti açıkça çevresinde koruyucu duvar bulunmayan dam yüzeyi olarak tanımlar. Bölgesel kullanım kaydı ile zayıf veya düzeltilmesi gereken bir söyleyiş biçimi referentin kimliğini değiştirmez, yalnızca sözcüğün kullanım ve biçim sınırlarını gösterir. facets.statement: Yapının üstünde yer alan ve çevresinde koruyucu duvar veya korkuluk bulunmayan dam yüzeyidir.
Kullanımın belirli bölgelere ait olduğu ve kırsal konuşmanın genel bir parçası olmadığı aktarılır.
Başında ek bir ünsüz bulunan söyleyiş, zayıf bir bölgesel biçim veya düzeltilmesi gereken kullanım sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tanımı çevresinde koruyucu duvar bulunmayan bir dam yüzeyidir. Kullanım belirli bölgelere bağlanır ve genel kırsal söz varlığına ait olmadığı belirtilir; farklı bir söyleyiş biçimi de kimi aktarımda zayıf, kiminde düzeltilmesi gereken biçim olarak değerlendirilir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök; kesip eksilterek sürekliliği bitirme, ayakta tutan güç, iyilik yapma ve başa kakma, tutsağı karşılıksız bırakma, eski bir ağırlık ölçüsü ve ağaçlara düşen tatlı doğal madde olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam dalında örgütlenir. Dallar arasında tarihsel çağrışımlar bulunabilse de çağdaş kavram haritasında tek bir çekirdeğe indirgenemeyen belirgin anlam ayrılıkları vardır.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.
